tools.name: website.read_form_responses

tools.description: Unpublishes an existing Carryo website so viewers immediately lose access through its shared link. Recovery availability depends on the website and is shown in Carryo. Unpublishing does not cancel a subscription.

findings.detail: Description of "website.save_draft" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: website.library, account.check_publishing, website.read, website.read_form_responses, website.read_version · Private data: website.library, website.publish, website.save_draft, website.read, website.edit_images, website.edit, website.list · Public sink: website.library, website.publish, website.save_draft, website.read_form_responses, website.edit_images, website.edit, website.list · Destructive: account.check_publishing, website.read_form_responses.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: website.library, account.check_publishing, website.read, website.read_form_responses, website.read_version · Private data: website.library, website.publish, website.save_draft, website.read, website.edit_images, website.edit, website.list · Public sink: website.library, website.publish, website.save_draft, website.read_form_responses, website.edit_images, website.edit, website.list · Destructive: account.check_publishing, website.read_form_responses

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
